{{Quote|"Dear Ashara. We're glad to hear you're happy and well. We're very proud that you've become a Jedi. Asher is nearly sixteen and plans to join Republic Special Forces."|Ashara Zavros reads the "letter from her parents."|<ref name="fear" />}}
'''Asher Zavros''' was the supposed brother of [[Ashara Zavros]], a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was active during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. While apprenticed to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox]], Ashara read a letter to her teacher that she claimed to be from her parents; the letter stated that a sixteen-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old Asher planned to join the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]].<ref name="fear" />

However, the veracity of the letter was questionable, as Ashara's parents, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Rolend Zavros|Rolen]] and [[Yanila Zavros]], [[Death/Legends|died]] more than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior, in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Asher Zavros is mentioned by the conversation "Fear and Longing" with the [[Sith Inquisitor]] companion Ashara Zavros in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. However, the letter she reads to the player does not line up with Ashara's own backstory, as laid out in other conversations and the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. Ashara herself states in the conversation "Masters" that her parents died in the Sacking of Coruscant, and she and the ''Encyclopedia'' say that she was adopted by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ryen]] and [[Ocera]] after her parents died. Thus, the validity of the letter's contents are suspect.
